subject: question about making a tab blank prior to data submission

messages.author: ce9985233c5ffc4f
messages.subject: question about making a tab blank prior to data submission
parts:
I created this simple web app to simulate some problems I am having with a more complex app I am trying to put together. My questions are:

  • Prior to submitting the test_data.csv file, the summary tab displays "ERROR: 'file' must be a character string or connection." Is there any way to adjust my code so that this tab remains blank prior to the user hitting "submit data?"

  • Once the test_data.csv file has been uploaded the tabs are immediately reactive.  Why is my "submit data" button not working?

  • The application I am building takes a much larger dataset on the order or 30mb.  Is there any way to create a processing results bar that is similar to the data upload bar so that users could see that the results are still processing?
Thanks in advance for any help somebody might be able to provide!

~Markus

messages.author: 5117fd6c9c423ce1
messages.subject: Re: question about making a tab blank prior to data submission
parts:
Hi, Marcus,

This seemed to work for me in my server.R, as a general example:

 
    output$contents1 <- renderTable({
      if(is.null(mycsvData()))
        return(NULL)
      return(
        (mycsvData())
      )
    })

so if there is nothing in mycsvData, nothing is displayed for that object. 

Hope this helps?
